What to look for: this shader casts an `out float4[2]` parameter to `float[8]`
inside an [unroll] loop. FXC (fxc_10_0_19041 pane) accepts it silently -- that
is the reporter's whole complaint, that legacy HLSL compilers took this
without a type-cast error. The dxc_1_6_2112 pane is CE's oldest available DXC
and sits inside this issue's transient "no crash" release window
(v1.5.2010..v1.6.2112, see notes.md): it does NOT crash, but it also does not
compile cleanly -- look for "error: validation errors" /
"Not all elements of output SV_ClipDistance were written". The dxc_trunk pane
is expected to reproduce the reporter's crash text verbatim,
"llvm::cast<X>() argument of incompatible type!" (Release build; the
project's local Debug ground truth instead traps a RewriteBitCast assertion,
which CE cannot show because CE ships Release builds only). Do not read a
clean-looking dxc_1_6_2112 pane as "fixed" -- it is a different failure, not
success.
